name: Reentry
author: mateu
description: Plasma around ships that fly fast through an atmosphere, made like the Firefly mod for KSP: glowing trails stream back from the ship's outline in two layers (hot yellow-orange core, rose and violet outer layer), a glowing shock cushion in front of the nose, sparks, smoke while cooling and a light. Driven by speed and air density with a reentry heating model scaled to the planet's orbital speed. Only visual
